description: Source code for the IRParser class and related functions in the PyTorch JIT compiler, responsible for parsing IR (Intermediate Representation) graphs from textual format.

classes.name: IRParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing textual IR representations into Torch JIT Graph objects.

classes.name: ParsedLiteral
classes.description: Struct representing a parsed literal value from IR, including various data types.

classes.name: VarWithType
classes.description: Struct representing a variable with an associated type in IR parsing.

methods.name: parseVar
methods.description: Parses a variable name from the IR input.

methods.name: parseVarWithType
methods.description: Parses a variable with optional type annotation.

methods.name: parseScalarLiteral
methods.description: Parses a scalar literal (string, number, tensor, etc.) from the IR input.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse the entire IR graph from input string.

methods.name: parseReturnOperator
methods.description: Parses the return statement of the IR graph.

methods.name: parseBlock
methods.description: Parses a block of IR statements.

methods.name: parseOperator
methods.description: Parses an individual IR operator statement.

methods.name: parseOperatorName
methods.description: Parses the operator name from the IR statement.

methods.name: parseOperatorInputs
methods.description: Parses inputs for an IR operator.

methods.name: parseAttrs
methods.description: Parses attributes for an IR node.

methods.name: parseAttr
methods.description: Parses a single attribute for an IR node.

methods.name: parseList
methods.description: Utility to parse a list of items delimited by specific tokens.

methods.name: findValueInVMap
methods.description: Finds a variable value in the variable map by name.
